title: Going to “the beach” except it’s never really a beach?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have visited similar recurring 'beach' dream environments / mismatch between perceived place and actual layout

locations.location_name: Artificial beach next to a car garage

position.relative_to: right next to a car garage

qualities.raw_description: Artificial beach right next to a car garage; sand; water is turquoise blue; grassy bushes; trees; coast is rounded; direct access to the water is very limited because it’s mainly surrounded by the grassy bushes and trees; 'When you happen upon it it’s like you stepped into a photo frame'; 'I feel so locked in when I look out at the water'; land is generally very peaceful; water has a menacing vibe; waves can be turned off with a remote; tarp appeared over the water.

locations.location_name: Car garage controlling the artificial beach

qualities.raw_description: A car garage next to the artificial beach; someone comes out of the garage and turns off all the waves with a remote control.

locations.location_name: Huge brick building with an indoor 'beach' pool

qualities.raw_description: A huge brick building with a 'beach' inside; beach is like an aquarium pool; cement walkways; pipes sticking out everywhere; lots of people in the water; dolphins jumping around in the corner of the building; dreamer walks around trying to balance on decaying cement beams over the pool; dreamer is too skittish to get in the water but is excited to be there.

position.relative_to: water/waves visible in the distance from inside the hut

qualities.raw_description: Cement beach hut; tons of people around; kind of junky; most similar to an actual public beach; never near the water; can look out between the beams of the cement hut and watch the waves in the distance; usually around sunset and the vibe is very chaotic; sometimes at night it’s completely empty; sometimes water dripping from the ceiling; hut similar to where beach showers would typically be.

connections.qualities: Garage is adjacent to the artificial beach; a person comes out of the garage onto/near the beach.

boundaries.description: Direct access to the water is very limited because it’s mainly surrounded by grassy bushes and trees; dreamer feels 'locked in' when looking out at the water; the scene is like stepping into a 'photo frame'.

interactions.description: A guy comes out (from the adjacent garage) and turns off all the waves with a remote control; then a tarp appears over the water; dreamer gets into a fight with him because he didn’t want the dreamer at 'his beach'.

entities_involved.description: Guy who comes out of the car garage and controls the waves with a remote; doesn't want dreamer at the beach.

interactions.description: Dreamer walks around the indoor pool area trying to balance on decaying cement beams over the pool; avoids getting into the water.

entities_involved.description: Lots of people in the water behaving as if enjoying an actual beach.
Dolphins jumping around in the corner of the building.

interactions.description: Dreamer looks out between cement beams of the hut and watches waves in the distance (not near the water).
At night when the hut area is completely empty, dreamer feels distressed trying to think of which direction to go to get home.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes three recurring 'beach' environments; treated as multiple recurring locations within the author's dream ecology rather than a single continuous scene. Some qualities (light, cleanliness) are only partially specified; time-of-day is explicit for the cement hut (sunset/night).
